children: DSM-Firmenich AG (EURONEXT:DSFIR) reported Q3 2026 revenue up 5.8% to €2.37 billion and adjusted EBITDA up 5.2% to €482 million, raising its full-year sales growth guidance to about 5% while keeping its margin outlook near 20%. Its animal nutrition and health unit, slated for sale to CVC, posted organic sales down 9% to €756 million.
: DSM-Firmenich’s Q3 2026 revenue rose 5.8% to €2.37 billion; adjusted EBITDA grew 5.2% to €482 million. It raised full-year sales growth guidance to about 5%, keeping its margin outlook near 20%.
: DSM-Firmenich (DSFIR) said its 2026–2028 plan and cost cuts remain on track. It completed its €540 million buyback on Sept. 30, 2026; shares are due to be cancelled by Q1 2027.
